# Watchfront

> Website monitoring software for agencies in India — uptime monitoring, SSL, forms, APIs, JS errors, SEO audits and client reports.

Watchfront helps agencies monitor client websites: uptime monitoring tool with downtime alerts, SSL certificate monitoring, domain expiry monitoring, contact form monitoring, API monitoring, JavaScript error monitoring, broken link checks, SEO audits, and white-label client website uptime reports.

Website: https://www.watchfront.in
Start free: https://www.watchfront.in/register
Contact: https://www.watchfront.in/contact
Full index: https://www.watchfront.in/llms-full.txt

Resources: https://www.watchfront.in/resources

## Product pages (non-brand search)

- [Website monitoring](https://www.watchfront.in/website-monitoring): website monitoring tool for agencies
- [Uptime monitoring tool](https://www.watchfront.in/uptime-monitoring-tool): 1-minute checks and downtime alerts
- [Website uptime monitor](https://www.watchfront.in/website-uptime-monitor): confirmed-outage uptime monitor
- [SSL certificate monitoring](https://www.watchfront.in/ssl-certificate-monitoring): expiry alerts and HTTPS checks
- [Website monitoring software](https://www.watchfront.in/website-monitoring-software): full platform overview
- [Website downtime monitoring](https://www.watchfront.in/website-downtime-monitoring): outage detection and incidents
- [Contact form monitoring](https://www.watchfront.in/contact-form-monitoring): real-browser form journeys
- [WordPress website monitoring](https://www.watchfront.in/wordpress-website-monitoring): care-plan monitoring for WP sites
- [API monitoring tool](https://www.watchfront.in/api-monitoring-tool): endpoint checks with assertions
- [JavaScript error monitoring](https://www.watchfront.in/javascript-error-monitoring-tool): real-visitor JS errors
- [Broken link checker & monitoring](https://www.watchfront.in/broken-link-checker-tool): dead links and content checks
- [Domain expiry monitoring](https://www.watchfront.in/domain-expiry-monitoring): registry expiry alerts across client domains
- [Website monitoring for agencies](https://www.watchfront.in/website-monitoring-for-agencies): portfolio retainers and reports
- [Synthetic monitoring](https://www.watchfront.in/synthetic-monitoring): scheduled checks that run overnight
- [Website availability monitoring](https://www.watchfront.in/website-availability-monitoring): availability checks with confirmation rules
- [Website health monitoring](https://www.watchfront.in/website-health-monitoring): availability + SSL + forms + SEO health
